title: Reading Your Sustainability Impact Report
summary: Explains how to read your monthly environmental sustainability impact report delivered each month in your digital documents center. It shows 18.0% of monthly maintenance fees directed to verified carbon offsets and estimates reforestation as 3 trees per $10,000 of average monthly balance, including formulas for calculating both.
